title: DragRuleNodes
description: Semantic rule-graph nodes (LHS/RHS clauses) moved by one relative offset in canvas units, read off each node's base position: its layout point, else its default slot. Ids the rule draws no node for are skipped (`mutation.partial`); none present is `mutation.target-missing`; a zero offset is `mutation.no-op`.

description.en: Rule-graph clause nodes to drag; ids the rule draws no node for are skipped.
description.de: Zu ziehende Klauselknoten des Regelgraphen; Ids ohne Knoten in der Regel werden übersprungen.

description.en: Horizontal offset every node moves by, in canvas units.
description.de: Horizontaler Versatz, um den jeder Knoten verschoben wird, in Leinwandeinheiten.

description.en: Vertical offset every node moves by, in canvas units.
description.de: Vertikaler Versatz, um den jeder Knoten verschoben wird, in Leinwandeinheiten.
